Any surviving Jedi might still obey the recall, and be killed.|[[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], after the initiation of [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]]|<ref name="RotSnovel">[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith (novelization)|''Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith'' novelization]]</ref>}}
The '''Jedi beacon''' was a communication system used by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. It allowed the [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]] to near-instantaneously contact all Jedi throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], without relying on the [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]]. The Council could program a mass signal broadcast, or a single message to one ship. It was housed in the [[Jedi Temple central security station/Legends|central security station]] in the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]]. In addition to the Temple's computer, each ship carried a small computer capable of sending out messages to other Jedi in the field. One possible message was [[Return-to-Coruscant]], an audio signal consisting of a series of accelerating beeps. It was intended to signal the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] and order all Jedi in the galaxy to return to the Temple.

During [[Operation: Knightfall/Legends|Operation: Knightfall]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] stormed the Archives and murdered Chief Librarian [[Jocasta Nu/Legends|Jocasta Nu]] when she refused to grant him access to the beacon, before ordering a number of [[clone assassin]]s to guard it. He then proceeded to broadcast the Return-to-Coruscant code to any Jedi who had survived [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] with the intention of luring them back to the Temple unaware of what had happened, where they would be murdered by the clones stationed at the Temple, some of whom were dressed in Jedi robes. Realizing what was happening to the Jedi, [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]] stole the beacon from recently deceased Master [[Saesee Tiin/Legends|Saesee Tiin's]] ship, the ''[[Sharp Spiral]]'' and managed to contact Master [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]. Meeting with [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] aboard the [[Sundered Heart/Legends|''Sundered Heart'']], the two Jedi agreed to [[Infiltration of the Jedi Temple/Legends|infiltrate]] the Temple and deactivate the beacon in order to prevent any survivors from stumbling into the trap.

After securing the security station, Kenobi altered the beacon to instead warn all surviving Jedi to flee into hiding. Since the changes to the beacon's mechanism were not visible, Kenobi believed that it would take the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] a long time to detect the recalibration and even longer to reset it.
